name: Susan Oster Fish
title: Trustee and Vice President, West Valley-Mission Community College District Board of Trustees
district: West Valley-Mission Community College District, Trustee Area 7
years_of_service: Elected in 2016; seeking re-election November 3, 2026. (District trustee page)
background: Fish is an attorney and registered nurse who has lived in the Santa Clara Valley most of her life. She is a West Valley College graduate, the parent of two West Valley graduates, and, per her district biography, a faculty spouse of 26 years. After working at two medical-malpractice defense firms, she opened her own firm in 2020, focused on medical-related law. (District trustee page)

Before joining the college board she served on the Town of Los Gatos Planning Commission and Rent Advisory Commission and on the board of trustees of Lincoln Law School of San Jose. On the community college board she is vice president, chairs the Audit and Budget Oversight Committee, and sits on the Mission-West Valley Land Corporation Investment Committee. She helped bring the College of Adaptive Arts to the West Valley campus. (District trustee page)
